diagnostics.title: Cartesian explosion: 832 rows for 1 PlexServerContent entities (Seasons, Episodes) at PlexContentRepository.cs:97 PlexServerContentRepository.GetByKey
diagnostics.explanation: Including two or more collections in one query makes EF Core LEFT JOIN each collection to the root in the same SELECT. The database returns one row for every combination: a PlexServerContent with 5 Seasons and 4 Episodes comes back as 20 rows, not 9. Here 1 PlexServerContent entities produced 832 rows (832 per root), and every one of those rows repeats all the PlexServerContent columns and the columns of the other collection. EF Core de-duplicates them in memory afterwards, so the app pays for transferring and parsing rows that carry no new information, and the multiplication grows with each additional collection.
